title: Sentinel — LLM Cost
description: P4-06 AC5: cost per tenant, the operations half of this ticket's own cost-budget guard (apps/analyst/src/cost-budget.ts). analyst_llm_cost_usd_total is incremented in the exact same place (cost-budget.ts's own recordUsage) the durable llm_usage Postgres row is written, so this panel and the budget check it mirrors can never drift apart. Panels query the metric names the otel-collector's Prometheus exporter actually produces for an OTel counter named analyst.llm.cost_usd (dots to underscores, _total appended) — the same naming convention golden-signals.json's own dashboard comment already confirmed live for http.server.*.

panels.title: Today's spend by tenant
panels.description: sum(increase(analyst_llm_cost_usd_total[24h])) by (tenant_id) — the same rolling-24h figure cost-budget.ts's own checkBudget compares against each plan's allowance/hard cap, so a tenant approaching its own cap is visible here before it ever degrades.

panels.title: Cost over time by tenant
panels.description: sum(rate(analyst_llm_cost_usd_total[1h])) by (tenant_id) * 3600 — hourly spend rate, so a sudden cost spike for one tenant is visible as a shape, not just a cumulative total.

panels.title: Prompt cache hit rate
panels.description: P4-05's own cache-hit metric, shown alongside cost since caching is the single largest lever on the number above: sum(increase(analyst_prompt_cache_hits_total[1h])) / sum(increase(analyst_prompt_cache_calls_total[1h])).

panels.title: Grounding rejection rate
panels.description: P4-04's own metric, shown here too since a degraded tenant (rule-only alerts) spends differently than a normal one: sum(increase(analyst_grounding_rejections_total[1h])) / sum(increase(analyst_grounding_attempts_total[1h])).
